groups.title: The original five
groups.def: The five original teenagers with attitude who first morphed as Mighty Morphin Power Rangers in the pilot. Tommy only joined later in Season 1 as the sixth Ranger.

groups.title: Zeo Rangers
groups.def: Everyone who wore a Zeo Ranger suit, including both Gold Zeo Rangers.

groups.title: Ninja Storm Rangers
groups.def: Everyone who morphed into a Wind, Thunder, or Samurai Ranger on the Ninja Storm team.

groups.title: Dino Thunder Rangers
groups.def: Everyone who morphed into a Dino Ranger, including the mentor who joined as Black Ranger.

groups.title: S.P.D. Rangers
groups.def: Everyone who morphed into an S.P.D. Ranger, B-Squad or otherwise.

groups.title: Mystic Force Rangers
groups.def: Everyone who morphed into a Mystic Force Ranger, including Daggeron's Solaris Knight.

groups.title: Operation Overdrive Rangers
groups.def: Everyone who morphed into an Operation Overdrive Ranger.

groups.title: Jungle Fury Rangers
groups.def: Everyone who morphed into a Jungle Fury Ranger (Red, Yellow, Blue, Wolf, Rhino). The Spirit Rangers aren't tiles; Jarrod's Black Lion Warrior and Camille's Green Chameleon Warrior were villain forms all season (the wiki calls their Ranger status 'debatable'), so they're out and 'The Dai Shi Clan' avoids this group.

groups.title: RPM Rangers
groups.def: Everyone who morphed into an RPM Ranger (their scientist ally Dr. K never suits up herself).

groups.title: Red & crimson Rangers
groups.def: Every tile who held a Red Ranger designation at any point in the covered seasons, crossovers included: Jason and Rocky (MMPR), Tommy (Zeo), Shane, Conner, Jack, Sky (S.P.D. Red in 'Reflection' and after Jack left), Bridge (S.P.D. Red in Overdrive's 'Once a Ranger'), Nick, Mack, Casey and Scott, plus Hunter, the Crimson Thunder Ranger, whom the wiki lists as Red. Temporary Reds who aren't tiles: Sensei Kanoi, Aurico, Leanbow.

groups.title: Blue & navy Rangers
groups.def: Every tile who held a Blue Ranger designation at any point in the covered seasons, crossovers included: Billy (MMPR), Rocky (Zeo), Tori, Ethan, Sky, Bridge (S.P.D. Blue after Sky moved to Red), Madison, Dax, Theo and Flynn, plus Blake, the Navy Thunder Ranger, whom the wiki lists as Blue. Kimberly morphing in Billy's body ('Switching Places'; the wiki calls her a temporary Blue) doesn't count, and this group avoids both Kimberly groups so she never shares its board. Cestro isn't a tile; Cruger's Shadow Ranger is Black.

groups.title: Yellow Rangers
groups.def: Every tile who held a Yellow Ranger designation at any point in the covered seasons, crossovers included: Trini and Aisha (MMPR), Tanya (Zeo), Dustin, Kira, Z, Chip, Ronny, Lily and Summer. Temporary Yellows who aren't tiles: Sensei Kanoi, Tideus.

groups.title: Pink Rangers
groups.def: Every tile who held a Pink Ranger designation at any point in the covered seasons, crossovers included: Kimberly (MMPR), Katherine (MMPR and Zeo), Syd, Vida and Rose. Billy morphing in Kimberly's body ('Switching Places'; the wiki calls him a temporary Pink) doesn't count, and he never shares this group's board ('The original five' is avoided here, 'Blue & navy Rangers' avoids this group); Marah's daydream (wiki: 'False Ranger') and Morgana's purple battlesuit aren't Ranger designations.

groups.title: Black Rangers
groups.def: Every tile who held a Black Ranger designation at any point in the covered seasons, crossovers included: Zack and Adam (MMPR; Adam again in 'Once a Ranger'), Tommy (Dino Thunder), Cruger (S.P.D. Shadow Ranger, wiki colour Black), Will and Dillon. Jarrod's Black Lion Warrior (wiki: 'debatable' Ranger status) doesn't count and 'The Dai Shi Clan' avoids this group; the Gold Zeo Ranger's black-and-gold suit is designated Gold (the wiki's Black list has neither Trey nor Jason); Corcus and the Bat Spirit Ranger aren't tiles.

groups.title: Mighty Morphin alien villains
groups.def: Every non-human villain tile from Mighty Morphin (Seasons 1-3 and Alien Rangers): Rita, Lord Zedd, Master Vile, Rito and their Moon Palace crew Goldar, Scorpina, Finster, Squatt and Baboo. Out: Tommy (Evil Green Ranger) and Katherine (Rita's spy) are human, although the wiki files both under Rita's faction and lists Tommy among the Moon Palace's generals (why this group is no longer titled after the palace); the Machine Empire debuts in Zeo and Thrax in Operation Overdrive.

groups.title: Machine Empire robots
groups.def: The robot royal family and servants of Zeo's Machine Empire: King Mondo, Queen Machina, Prince Gasket, Princess Archerina, Prince Sprocket, Klank and Orbus (all in the wiki's Machine Empire category). Tommy, whom Gasket brainwashed into believing he was its king in 'King for a Day', is human and not in the category. The Wild Force 'General Venjix' was a Machine Empire general with the same name as the RPM Venjix tile, so this group avoids 'Venjix's network'.

groups.title: Lothor's generals
groups.def: The named generals of Lothor's army in Ninja Storm. Lothor himself leads it, and his nieces Kapri and Marah are henchwomen, not generals; the Rangers he tricked or brainwashed never were.

groups.title: Green Rangers
groups.def: Every tile who held a Green Ranger designation at any point in the covered seasons, crossovers included: Tommy (MMPR), Adam (Zeo), Cam, Bridge (S.P.D. Green before his promotions), Xander and Ziggy. Camille's Green Chameleon Warrior (wiki: 'debatable' Ranger status) doesn't count and 'The Dai Shi Clan' avoids this group; Jason only carried Tommy's Dragon Coin as the Red Ranger ('The Green Candle'); Tommy's clone and the Elephant Spirit Ranger aren't tiles.

groups.title: White Rangers
groups.def: Every tile who held a White Ranger designation at any point in the covered seasons, crossovers included: Tommy (MMPR), Trent, Sam (S.P.D. Omega Ranger), Udonna and Dominic (Rhino Ranger). Delphine and the White Dino Ranger clone aren't tiles.

groups.title: Gold Rangers
groups.def: Every tile who held a Gold Ranger designation at any point in the covered seasons, crossovers included: Trey and Jason (Gold Zeo Ranger), Daggeron (Solaris Knight) and Gem. Billy's failed attempt to absorb the Gold powers (his body rejected them) doesn't count; the Sentinel Knight isn't a tile.

groups.title: Mentors who never morphed
groups.def: The team mentors of the covered seasons who never morph: Zordon (MMPR/Zeo), Alpha 5 (Zordon's aide, wiki type 'Mentor', sole mentor while Zordon was lost), Andrew Hartford (Operation Overdrive; he planned to be Red but let Mack), Master Mao (Jungle Fury) and Dr. K (RPM). They are the only non-Ranger hero/ally tiles, so nobody else can fit; villains aren't mentors.

groups.title: Troobian Empire
groups.def: The tiles in the wiki's Troobian Empire category (S.P.D.'s villains): Emperor Gruumm, Omni (its secret true leader) and Gruumm's two aides, Mora/Morgana and the arms dealer Broodwing. Sam was only Mora's pawn and never joined; the A-Squad aren't tiles.

groups.title: Mystic Force villains
groups.def: The Mystic Force villain tiles, all in the wiki's Morlocks category: Octomus the Master, his generals Morticon and Imperious, the vampire queen Necrolai (turned human only in the finale) and the Ten Terrors' leader Sculpin. Nick (possessed into a new Koragg in 'Mystic Fate') and Vida (a vampire serving Necrolai in 'Stranger Within') are wiki 'Good turned Evil' Rangers, so this group avoids every group either of them is in.
avoid: Rangers with a villain in the family

groups.title: Operation Overdrive villains
groups.def: The Operation Overdrive villain tiles (wiki season page villain list): the jewel-hunting brothers Flurious and Moltor, Kamdor and Miratrix, and Thrax, Rita and Zedd's son, who united the factions into the Evil Alliance in 'Once a Ranger'. Tyzonn was forced to serve Moltor as a monster before becoming the Mercury Ranger (wiki 'Good turned Evil'), so this group avoids both of his groups.

groups.title: The Dai Shi Clan
groups.def: The Jungle Fury tiles in the wiki's Dai Shi Clan category: the spirit Dai Shi, Jarrod (his host, redeemed at the end), Camille (redeemed at the end) and the Overlords Carnisoar and Grizzaka. The wiki gives Jarrod's Black Lion Warrior and Camille's Green Chameleon Warrior 'debatable' Ranger status, so this group avoids the Black, Green and Jungle Fury Ranger groups.

groups.title: Venjix's network
groups.def: The RPM tiles in the wiki's Venjix Computer Network category: Venjix, its generals Kilobyte and General Shifter, and Tenaya (Dillon's sister, who defects near the end). Dillon only carries Venjix hardware as a former test subject and Dr. K created Venjix; neither is in the category. 'Machine Empire robots' avoids this group because Wild Force's Machine Empire had a 'General Venjix'.

groups.title: Lothor's family
groups.def: Lothor (Kiya Watanabe, twin of Sensei Kanoi) and his relatives: his nieces Kapri and Marah, and his nephew Cam, the Sensei's son.

groups.title: Ranger siblings on one team
groups.def: Rangers whose brother or sister is a Ranger on the same team: Vida and Madison (Mystic Force), twins Gem and Gemma (RPM), adoptive brothers Hunter and Blake (Ninja Storm). Dillon's sister Tenaya is a villain.

groups.title: Villains with a villain sibling
groups.def: Villains whose brother or sister is also a villain: Rita and her brother Rito, Mondo's sons Gasket and Sprocket, the brothers Flurious and Moltor, and the sisters Kapri and Marah. Lothor's twin and Tenaya's brother are heroes; Hunter and Blake, adoptive brothers who both fought for Lothor early in Ninja Storm (wiki 'Good turned Evil'), are kept off this group's boards by the 'siblings' family and avoids on their other groups.

groups.title: Rangers with a villain in the family
groups.def: Rangers with a season villain as a close relative: Nick and Udonna (his father, her husband Leanbow, was Koragg), Trent (adoptive father Anton Mercer is Mesogog), Cam (uncle Lothor) and Dillon (sister Tenaya). Hunter and Blake (each other's brother, both fought for Lothor) and Madison (sister Vida was briefly a vampire) could be argued in via the wiki's 'Good turned Evil' Rangers, so this group avoids every group they're in.

groups.title: Inherited a Power Coin
groups.def: Took over one of the original five's Power Coins: Rocky, Adam and Aisha from Jason, Zack and Trini ('The Power Transfer'), and Katherine from Kimberly ('A Different Shade of Pink'). Tanya's Zeo sub-crystal isn't a coin and Tommy's coins were new. Jason held Tommy's Dragon Coin after 'The Green Candle', so this group avoids the two Jason groups that could share its board ('Zeo Rangers' and 'Red & crimson Rangers' overlap it too much to be dealt with it).

groups.title: The 'Once a Ranger' veterans
groups.def: The five former Rangers the Sentinel Knight calls in when the Overdrive team loses its powers in Operation Overdrive's 'Once a Ranger': Adam, Tori, Kira, Bridge and Xander.

groups.title: Heroes from other planets
groups.def: Heroes or allies whose wiki homeworld is another planet: Zordon (Eltar), Alpha 5 (Edenoi), Trey (Triforia), Cruger (Sirius) and Tyzonn (Mercuria). Every other hero tile's homeworld is Earth, including the Mystic Force wizards (Earth's Magic World) and the future S.P.D. cadets. Rita (M51 Galaxy) is an ally as the Mystic Mother in Mystic Force, so this group avoids both Rita groups.
